summary: Wrapper that normalizes trailing backslashes on the input path via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer, then returns the result of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc applied to the same string argument.

operations.description: Call PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer(a1) to normalize trailing backslashes on the input path before copying.
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1) and return its result, producing a copy of the (now normalized) path string.
Return the value returned by StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1).

unresolved: Why both a normalizer and a copy are applied to the same argument is unresolved; the caller's use of the returned string is unknown.
Whether the return value of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc is a new allocation or a borrowed buffer is unresolved from static evidence.
